correctness.rationale: The reduced common support is exactly the incidence of two p-planes in a (p+1)-plane. The ordered incidence bundle \(\mathbb P(S^\vee)\times_T\mathbb P(S^\vee)\) is irreducible, generically double over its reduced image, and has dimension D. The pulled-back standard Chow-form hyperplane is \(x+y-2c_1(S)\), not x+y. Projective-bundle pushforward and torus localization give the finite factorial sum for every admissible p,n. Annihilator duality preserves the Chow polarization and yields the symmetry. In the line case, the degeneracy locus has expected codimension and Thom--Porteous/Pieri/reflection give the binomial sum. Exact independent computations in all 15 pairs with \(n\le7\) agree. No finite experiment is used as the proof of all-parameter identities.

value.rationale: The overlap of the quadric and pair components is a geometrically canonical incidence stratum of degree-two Chow varieties. Its Chow projective degree is a natural enumerative invariant not fixed by the separate component degrees. The result determines it in every admissible dimension, yields a closed binomial expression for all pairs of lines and a uniform duality, and produces explicit new higher-dimensional values; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice or mere reproduction of a known component-degree table.
